These are symbolic associations, not a measurement of your personality; keep what fits your experience and question what does not.

entries.title: Ketu in Meena
entries.body: This sign adds themes of imagination and empathy to the planet's traditional focus on reflection and simplifying. A practical reflection is to pair compassion with workable limits. These are symbolic associations, not a measurement of your personality; keep what fits your experience and question what does not.
